# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 27 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Policy Update: BTO & EC Income Ceilings Raised

- **HDB BTO income ceiling raised to S$16,000; EC ceiling raised to S$18,000** - Prime Minister Lawrence Wong announced at the National Day Rally that the income ceiling for HDB BTO family applicants rises to S$16,000 and for singles to S$8,000, effective 24 August 2026, while the Executive Condominium ceiling moves to S$18,000. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/ndr-2026-bto-income-ceiling-raised-to-s16000-ec-ceiling-to-s18000/)

- **What the new income ceilings mean in practice** - Stacked Homes breaks down the updated BTO and EC eligibility thresholds announced on 23 August 2026, covering which buyer groups are affected and the timeline for the changes taking effect. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-raises-income-ceiling-to-16k-and-ec-ceiling-to-18k/)

## HDB Resale Market: Supply and Records

- **18,425 HDB flats reaching MOP in 2026 across 22 projects** - Analysis identifies which towns will see the most newly MOP-ed flats enter the resale market this year, including breakdowns by flat type and where prices remain competitive. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/18425-hdb-flats-could-reach-mop-2026-where-buyers-will-have-most-choice/)

- **Pasir Ris DBSS five-room flat sells for S$1.15 million, a new record** - A unit at 530D Pasir Ris Drive 1 transacted at S$1,150,000 (S$1,018 psf) in August 2026, setting a new resale high for the flat type in Pasir Ris — S$167,000 above the previous record, and not on the top floor. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/5-room-pasir-ris-dbss-flat-set-a-new-1-15m-record-167k-above-previous-high/)

- **Bishan's first 4-room HDB resale flat crosses S$1.3 million** - A 4-room flat in Bishan changed hands for S$1.3 million in August 2026 at approximately S$1,271 psf, setting both a new town transaction record and a new town-wide psf record for the flat type. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/bishan-4-room-hdb-records-first-1-3m-natura-loft/)

## Rental Market: Condos and Prime Homes

- **Condo rental prices and volumes both hit all-time highs in July 2026** - Singapore's private condo rental market recorded its highest-ever prices and transaction volumes simultaneously in July 2026, with the HDB rental market also reported to have strengthened over the same period. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-rental-prices-volumes-record-high-july-2026/)

- **Singapore prime home capital values forecast to grow 2% to 3.9% in H2 2026** - Prime rents rose 1.7% in H1 2026, ahead of the 1.1% global average tracked by Savills across 30 cities, with Singapore's H2 outlook among the strongest in that group; prime capital values grew just 0.4% in H1. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapore-prime-home-prices-grew-0-4-first-half-2026-2-signs-point-stronger-second-half/)
